purpose: Determine whether the original causal Industry Diffusion score contains stable payoff ordering inside the frozen Champion's ten selected names, and concentrate capital once only if it does.

frozen_signal.domain: exact executed frozen Champion names on each weekly signal date
frozen_signal.score: same-date causal diffusion_score from the accepted daily feature panel

sequential_periods.validation_access: only if every generation gate passes

single_executable_translation.authorization: only if both sequential gates pass
single_executable_translation.rule: From each frozen Champion Top-10 cohort, keep the five names with the highest diffusion_score; break score ties by lower max_return20 then symbol.
single_executable_translation.capital: use the unchanged Champion cohort capital and redistribute it equally across executable retained names
single_executable_translation.exit: unchanged 20-session due-open plus QD-010 and legal-fill handling

prohibited: alternative score, rank, cutoff, Top-N, schedule, horizon, cost, weighting, or tie rule
daily refresh, exit overlay, habitat filter, leverage, or second replay
OOS, independent confirmation, or live claim
